te: Petition on state service contracts considered
se: The meeting considered a petition from state service contract workers, who stated that they had been affected by the Comptroller General's Department circular on revising service contracts, and asked for help in solving the problem
it: Petition on the effects of the circular on state service contracts

te: Riders' problems and independent workers' savings heard
se: The meeting studied approaches to solving the problems of protecting independent workers and platform workers, inviting representatives of the National Savings Fund, the Department of Labour Protection and Welfare and riders' groups to give information on matters such as competition that cuts fares per trip until they no longer reflect costs, a lack of bargaining power, and weaknesses in the identity checks of riders on the applications
it: Approaches to solving the problems of protecting independent workers and platform workers

te: Draft law on promoting and protecting independent workers followed up
se: The meeting studied approaches to solving the problems of protecting independent workers and platform workers, focusing on the draft Independent Workers Promotion and Protection Act B.E. ...., which is awaiting submission to the Council of Ministers and still needs a clear welfare system. It heard representatives of employees' organisations and discussed the particular problems of Muay Thai boxers and trainers
it: Draft Independent Workers Promotion and Protection Act B.E. ....
Problems in protecting Muay Thai boxers and trainers

te: International approaches to platform work heard
se: The meeting studied approaches to solving the problems of protecting independent workers and platform workers, hearing an analysis of legal issues and labour rights in the platform economy and a comparison of approaches abroad, especially on whether workers are classified as independent contractors or as employees
it: Approaches to solving the problems of protecting independent workers and platform workers

te: Problems of massage workers, riders and housekeepers heard
se: The meeting studied approaches to solving the problems of protecting independent workers and platform workers, inviting representatives of massage workers, riders and housekeepers to give information on the lack of welfare, unsafe working conditions and control systems of the applications. The representatives proposed that the state push for a protection law and access to social security under section 33
it: Approaches to solving the problems of protecting independent workers and platform workers

se: The meeting studied approaches to solving the problems of protecting independent workers and platform workers, inviting representatives of various occupations, such as film crew members, writers, translators and night-time musicians, to describe obstacles such as long working hours and welfare that does not yet cover them
it: Approaches to solving the problems of protecting independent workers and platform workers

se: The meeting studied approaches to solving the problems of protecting independent workers and platform workers, inviting representatives of networks of informal workers, home workers and street vendors to give information. They stated that there are about 21 million informal workers, of whom about 10–11 million are insured under section 40, but only about 1.4 million pay contributions regularly
it: Approaches to solving the problems of protecting independent workers and platform workers

te: Framework set for studying labour issues in 2026
se: The meeting considered the framework for its study under the work plan for fiscal year 2026, setting 5 main topics, such as independent and platform workers, with an emphasis on hearing the views of all sides, from employees and employers to the state, and considered setting up working groups under the plan
it: Framework for study under the work plan, fiscal year 2026
Setting up working groups under the work plan

te: Petition on the dismissal of service contract workers considered
se: The meeting considered a petition in which the petitioner alleged that cleaning service contract workers at a state enterprise were unfairly dismissed and did not receive severance pay under the labour protection law, inviting representatives of the former employer, the Department of Labour Protection and Welfare and the agencies concerned to give the facts
it: Petition on the dismissal of service contract workers at a state enterprise

te: Meeting 1/2569 · Subcommittee on Labour Welfare and Protection
Mr. Nirutti Suttinon elected Chair of the committee
se: Mr. Virat Rakpan submitted a letter resigning as Chair of the committee. The meeting therefore elected Mr. Nirutti Suttinon, First Vice-Chair of the committee, as Chair of the Committee on Labour to fill the vacancy
it: Chair of the committee elected to fill the vacancy

te: Principles set for the committee's staff during the election period
se: The meeting discussed guidance for people working for the committee who are not senators during the election of members of the House of Representatives on 8 February 2026. It resolved that anyone who will stand as a candidate or take part in political activities should resign, in line with the Constitution, and noted the guidance on the duties of the Council of Ministers after the dissolution of the House
it: Guidance for people working for the committee during the election period
Guidance on the duties of the Council of Ministers after the dissolution of the House

te: Guidance on the Senate's work while there is no House of Representatives noted
se: The meeting noted the guidance on the duties of the Senate, senators and committees while there is no House of Representatives after its dissolution, under section 126 of the Constitution
it: Guidance on the duties of the Senate and its committees while there is no House of Representatives

te: Draft Royal Decree on renewing job placement licences studied
se: As assigned by the Special Committee on Senate Affairs, the meeting studied the draft Royal Decree requiring licence holders to pay a licence renewal fee instead of applying for licence renewal, which adds licences under the job placement law, such as licences for job placement in Thailand and abroad
it: Draft Royal Decree requiring licence holders to pay a licence renewal fee instead of applying for renewal (No. ..) B.E. ....

te: Report on the National Labour Development Digital Platform (NLDD) considered
se: The meeting considered the study report on the concept of a National Labour Development Digital Platform (NLDD) by the Subcommittee on Employment Services and Skills Development, which proposes building the platform as national infrastructure and developing workers' digital and AI skills throughout their lives
it: Study report on the concept of a National Labour Development Digital Platform (NLDD)

te: Subcommittee assigned to gather information on petitions
se: The meeting considered 2 petitions, such as a case in which the petitioner alleged that cleaning staff on service contracts at a state agency were not given new contracts after the contractor changed, even though they had worked continuously, and assigned the Subcommittee on Labour Welfare and Protection to gather information and give its views
it: Petition on service contract staff at a state agency not being given new contracts
